description: Versioned authoring contracts read by the assistant; not a native command parser or validator for creative semantics.
growth_rules: Add operation, version, input/output types, persistence behavior and an existing handler before advertising a new command.
Use the shared record envelope and runtime; no independent pointer allocator inside a workflow.
Add meaningful behavior tests for new persistence invariants; include help and migration notes for breaking changes.
Bump record schema_version only with an explicit migration; never silently rewrite historical records.
Skill versions and definition versions are distinct from artifact revision numbers. Record all relevant versions in provenance.
